author: Hank Green
description:
I'm start to see some cracks in the bizarre exterior here...I think people are waking up to what a con man this guy is...

US cases

2026 cases by age and vaccination status: https://www.contagionlive.com/view/measles-update-october-9-2026

Vaccination and exemptions
Coverage for every country- WHO Immunization Data Portal - https://immunizationdata.who.int/
US kindergarten MMR coverage and exemptions https://data.cdc.gov/Vaccinations/Vaccination-Coverage-and-Exemptions-among-Kinderga/ijqb-a7ye
On-time first MMR doses https://www.truveta.com/blog/research/delayed-or-absent-first-dose-of-measles-mumps-and-rubella-vaccination/

Population and wealth
